# appwrite_tablesdb (Data Source)

Fetches an Appwrite database by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "appwrite_tablesdb" "main" {
  id = "main"
}

output "database_name" {
  value = data.appwrite_tablesdb.main.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The database ID.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The database creation timestamp.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the database is enabled.
- `name` (String) The database name.
- `updated_at` (String) The database last update timestamp.
